title: Bi-EZP: LLM-Guided Bilevel Program Evolution for Ensemble Zero-Cost Proxy Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2608.21927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zero-cost proxies enable neural architecture search (NAS) to rank candidate networks from statistics computed at initialization, avoiding repeated training. However, different proxies capture different properties and often produce inconsistent rankings across search spaces. Ensemble proxies can combine complementary signals, but automated discovery must optimize both discrete aggregation structures and their continuous coefficients, making structural quality difficult to separate from parameter calibration. We propose Bi-EZP, a bilevel framework that decouples these decisions. At the upper level, a large language model generates executable aggregation programs over four complementary base proxies with program-specific parameter bounds. At the lower level, covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) optimizes the continuous parameters of each fixed program on an inner training split. translated_title: Bi-EZP：基于大语言模型引导的双层程序演化用于集成零成本代理发现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21927v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：零成本代理使得神经架构搜索（NAS）能够根据初始化时计算的统计信息对候选网络进行排序，从而避免重复训练。然而，不同的代理捕获不同的特性，并且在不同搜索空间上往往产生不一致的排名。集成代理可以结合互补信号，但自动发现必须同时优化离散的聚合结构及其连续系数，这使得结构质量难以与参数校准分离。我们提出了Bi-EZP，一种双层框架，用于解耦这些决策。在上层，大语言模型生成可执行的聚合程序，这些程序基于四个互补的基础代理，并带有程序特定的参数界限。在下层，协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）在内部训练分割上优化每个固定程序的连续参数。校准后的程序随后被评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种双层框架Bi-EZP，通过大语言模型生成聚合程序结构，并用CMA-ES优化连续参数，从而解耦集成零成本代理的结构与参数优化，提升NAS排名一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Bi-EZP, a bilevel framework that decouples structural and parameter optimization for ensemble zero-cost proxies by using LLMs to generate aggregation programs and CMA-ES to calibrate continuous coefficients, improving NAS ranking consistency.
